content.text:
You probably can't buy an M4 MacBook Air from the US Apple Store anymore. Apple's MacBook Air page now lists only M5 models, and I couldn't confirm that any M4 models are still on sale there.

**M5 MacBook Air, US list prices (current successor):**
- **13-inch:** starts at $1,099.
- **15-inch:** starts at $1,299.
- Both sizes now come with 512GB of base storage. The M4 started at 256GB.

**M4 MacBook Air:**
- When the M5 launched, Apple cut the M4's starting price to $999. The 512GB M4 had been $1,199.
- I found no confirmation that Apple still sells it. Apple's page didn't list prices, so I got the M5 prices from press coverage.
- Third-party retailers such as Amazon have discounted M4 models heavily. One report had the base 13-inch (16GB RAM, 256GB) at $749.99, though it was undated and may no longer apply.

For an exact figure today, check apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-air. Apple's Refurbished store may also carry M4 units.

- [Macworld: Apple changes prices on new M5 MacBook Air](https://www.macworld.com/article/3076520/apple-changes-prices-new-m5-macbook-air-m5-pro-max-macbook-pro.html)
